Callout.Name: Hotel Room - Damage and Dispute
Callout.Message: Damage to a hotel room and a dispute over the bill.
Callout.Advisory: Guest still in the room, staff locked out.

Script.Line: The room was like that when I came in.
I have paid for the room. I am not paying for the mirror.
I want a receipt. I want all of it written down.

Lines.Approach: The room is wrecked and the guest will not come out. The staff want the room number and the bill paid.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
